archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY

headings.usage_rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for large headings. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage_rules: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and functional UI text.

technical_specs.usage_rules: Use exclusively for product specifications, measurements, and technical badges. Use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.rules: Avoid default generic colors. The brand colors serve as functional accents on a high-contrast structural baseline (Obsidian & Bone White). Remove all simple linear gradients.

visual_enhancers.texture: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-4%) globally to eliminate digital flatness and create a physical, architectural feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers/navs: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, backdrop-saturate-150, border-b border-black/5. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: For product specification tables and feature grids: Use the 'Technical Look' with border-collapse and 1px border-black/10 on right and bottom of grid items.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for main sections. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 padding.
layouts_and_grids.portfolio_showcase: Use 'MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID'. Asymmetric grid mapping (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Mix hero elements (col-span-8) with supporting squares (col-span-4).
layouts_and_grids.product_catalog: Use 'MODE B: High Density Grid'. Minimal padding between technical specs to create a dense, informative layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6).
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Never center-everything.

product_cards.style: Flat solid background or slight grain, 1px solid border (border-black/10). Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). No soft blurry shadows.
product_cards.hover: Slight image scale (scale-105) within an overflow-hidden container. Border darkens.
product_cards.information_hierarchy: Overline (JetBrains Mono, Uppercase) -> Product Name (Chivo, large) -> Key Spec -> CTA.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast solid color (Brand Primary or Obsidian).
buttons.hover: Must have explicit hover states: hover:bg-black/90 or hover:bg-[brand-hover].

category_headers.style: Massive typography (text-6xl to text-8xl) tightly tracked. Remove all gradient text effects. Use solid black or solid brand color.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: MANDATORY: Install and configure 'lenis' for momentum/smooth scrolling to achieve a premium architectural feel.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use Framer Motion for staggered entrance animations on product grids and 'Tracing Beam' effects on premium portfolio cards.
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Images should have a slow, subtle parallax effect on scroll. Buttons should have a slight transform on click.

media.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Ensure subjects are present to avoid artificial feeling.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Use text shadow if text is over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='canobond-explore-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace generic gradient headers with massive, tightly-tracked solid typography using Chivo.
2. Strip away default centered layouts and implement the asymmetric 'Tetris Grid' with ample negative space (py-24).
3. Apply specific brand color themes as accents rather than overwhelming backgrounds; use tinted neutrals for section backgrounds.
4. Add a global SVG noise overlay to give the site a tactile, premium material feel.
5. Use JetBrains Mono for product specifications and technical badges to establish B2B authority.
6. Setup lenis smooth scrolling for a premium browsing experience.
7. Ensure no transparent backgrounds are used on the navigation header; use the crystal glassmorphism technique.
8. Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone weight for high-end feel.
9. Use the provided high-quality Unsplash image URLs for the distinct sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Ensure creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Apply transitions to specific properties.
Do NOT add '.App { text-align: center; }'. Left-align text for natural reading.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Components MUST use named exports, pages MUST use default exports.
